statements:
Counts: volume of n congruent unit tetrahedra divided by
volume of m congruent unit tetrahedra is exactly n/m (m > 0).

Dilation: an n/m edge-scale ratio gives area ratio (n/m)²
and volume ratio (n/m)³ for the same shape.

Every rational has an integer-pair representation.
Irrational constants require approximation or a limiting process.
